sehemu: Part I: Dispensation of Justice in the United Republic
maudhui: (1) The authority with final decision in the dispensation of justice in the United Republic shall be vested in the Judiciary. (2) In delivering decisions in civil and criminal matters in accordance with the law, the courts shall observe the following principles: (a) impartiality to all without regard to social or economic status; (b) not to delay justice without reasonable ground; (c) to award reasonable compensation to victims of wrongs committed by other persons in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament; (d) to promote and enhance dispute resolution among persons involved in disputes; and (e) to dispense justice without being unduly bound by technical provisions which may obstruct justice.
